items.title: 5 new Google Flow Tools designed by visual artists
items.excerpt: Google added five creative tools to Flow, its AI filmmaking studio, built with visual artists: they keep characters consistent across decades, generate stylized art, simulate complex lighting and turn phone videos into polished shots.

items.title: How 3D Transforms and Figma's Agent Brought a Launch Video to Life
items.excerpt: Figma's Brand Studio team made a launch video on the canvas, combining the new native 3D transforms with tools built by Figma's agent, plus shaders and motion.

history_match.title: Explore Shaders and Motion with the Figma agent | Figma on Figma

items.title: Framer Updates: Image and Shader Generation
items.excerpt: The Framer Agent can now generate or edit images, textures and illustrations and create or tweak shaders such as halftone, bokeh or CRT. It can also feed a generated image into an image shader.

history_match.title: Explore Shaders and Motion with the Figma agent | Figma on Figma

items.title: Introducing image and shader generation in Framer
items.excerpt: Framer's official demo of its Agent generating custom images, textures, illustrations and shaders (halftone, bokeh blur, CRT) directly on the site canvas.

history_match.title: Explore Shaders and Motion with the Figma agent | Figma on Figma

items.title: When Video Becomes an Interface | inside view
items.excerpt: An inside look at Runway Labs, where designers prototype what real-time video models make possible, with video itself acting as the interface.

items.title: Claude +MCP Framer Hero section
items.excerpt: Designer Jesse Showalter connects Claude to Framer through MCP and builds a scroll-controlled video hero section, walking through the workflow step by step.

items.title: Rhino World 2026: McNeel lets AI in
items.excerpt: With Rhino 9 out, AEC Magazine reports from Rhino World 2026 on how McNeel is bringing AI into Rhino and speeding up development without changing its perpetual-licence business model.

items.title: BCN3D's Aurora 3D Printer Generates Parts using AI Parametric Design
items.excerpt: BCN3D's Aurora is an industrial IDEX FFF printer with built-in AI parametric design. It's billed as a '3 in 1' system combining AI 3D modeling, smart slicing and 2D-to-3D AI design, so users can produce parts without doing any 3D design themselves.

history_match.title: This AI 3D Printer Can Now Design Your Parts, Too. I Have Questions.

items.title: Creality's new mBox is an AI-enabled 3D printer for kids
items.excerpt: Creality's $329 mBox is a compact, kid-safe 3D printer for ages 6-16. It works with the CubeMe and SnapForm AI tools, which turn photos or drawings into printable 3D models, and uses built-in AI detection to monitor prints.

history_match.title: This AI 3D Printer Can Now Design Your Parts, Too. I Have Questions.

items.title: The Definitive Fine-Tuning Guide for 3D Generation Models
items.excerpt: Hugging Face shows how to LoRA-fine-tune the TRELLIS.2 image-to-3D pipeline on one object category (Google Scanned Objects), covering which structure, geometry and material components to train and which to freeze.

history_match.title: How we're training a Figma-fluent editing model

items.title: Phota Labs uses AI to turn everyday photos into professional-looking shots
items.excerpt: Phota Labs isn't another manual photo editor: it uses AI to automate the edit itself, so anyone can turn everyday snapshots into professional-looking photos.

items.title: Should You Actually Add AI To That? A Four-Question Audit For Product Teams
items.excerpt: An AI feature can save users time on a task, then cost them that time checking its output. Smashing offers a four-question audit for deciding where AI earns its place in a product and what users need to trust it.

items.title: KT, 앱 디자인부터 고객 안내 문구까지 AI 적용…'KDS 2.0' 구축
items.excerpt: KT built KDS 2.0, a UX design system that AI can read directly. Its 'KDS Harness' lets AI lay out screens to the system's rules and check the results, cutting about 8 months of work (424 requirements, 25 components) to 2 months 40 days. KT also launched an AI message-writing agent that cuts drafting and review from 30-60 minutes to about 5.

items.title: Every click has a price now. Who designs how that 'feels'?
items.excerpt: As AI products move from all-you-can-eat plans to credit- and token-based pricing, every action has a cost. UX designers now have to design how that metering feels to users.

items.title: Why are we cloning Photoshop?
items.excerpt: AI has made professional tools cheap to rebuild, as the AI-built open-source Photoshop clone PhotoCraft shows. The author argues designers are missing a bigger opportunity than cloning legacy interfaces.

history_match.title: Adobe is testing how well AI agents can use editing tools like a Photoshop professional would

items.title: The AI mind tax that afflicts those who use AI best
items.excerpt: For the heaviest AI users, managing a dozen unconnected AI tools has become a second job, and an exhausting one. The piece looks at how creative workers keep their judgment sharp.

items.title: Android XR Glasses from Warby Parker & Gentle Monster Coming Dec. 10th, Pre-orders Now Live
items.excerpt: Gentle Monster and Warby Parker will ship their first Android XR smart glasses, built with Samsung and Google and running Gemini, on December 10. Pre-orders are open now.

items.title: Unreal Engine 5.9 divides game devs with an AI-heavy update
items.excerpt: Epic's Unreal Engine 5.9 preview leans heavily on AI agents ('Invite your agents'), which has split game developers and 3D artists.

items.title: So, what are the best AI video generators, and how do they compare on price?
items.excerpt: Creative Bloq compares the leading AI video generators on capability and price to help creatives choose a tool.

items.title: Lovable vs Figma Make: Who Keeps the Code?
items.excerpt: A November 2026 comparison of Lovable and Figma Make: seats and AI credits, figma.site publishing, a key-value backend versus Postgres, and Figma Make's one-way GitHub push.

items.title: Google's Gemini 4 Hydrogen outscores the bigger Argon just four weeks after its launch
items.excerpt: Gemini 4 Hydrogen replaces Google's Flash series and nearly matches Claude Sonnet 5.5 on the Artificial Analysis index for less money. It's now available in Google AI Studio and on Vercel's AI Gateway for agentic coding and app building.

items.title: More game developers are starting to use generative AI
items.excerpt: The GDC Festival of Gaming's annual survey shows generative-AI use rising among game developers, highest at free-to-play (58%) and mobile-only studios (70%), even as many indie developers push back against the technology.
